aj: CI red on linux-x64 unit job #3421 — TestStreamAllocatorInterleave failed on main. Seen locally ~3/10 runs. Can someone take a quick look? @devon ?
ci-bot: build failed: job 3421 — https://ci.redwood/3421 — failing test output attached.
maria: can you paste the failing snippet and the commit SHA?
aj: here's the tail of the failing log:
```
--- FAIL: TestStreamAllocatorInterleave (0.12s)
allocator_test.go:128: expected order [A B C] but got [A C B]
--- FAIL
seed=87345
last goroutine: runtime stack...
```
commit range: abc123..def456 (merge to main yesterday)
devon: I touched that allocator test a while back. Looks like an order/timing nondeterminism, possibly related to the scheduler change in abc123.
kaito: I can run a bisect. please confirm range and whether we have a reproducible seed. I'll also try repeated local runs with the seed.
aj: confirmed range abc123..def456. Local repro command I used: `TEST_SEED=87345 go test ./runtime -run TestStreamAllocatorInterleave -count=100 -v` — sometimes it fails within a few runs. Also try with `-race` and `-test.timeout=2m`.
maria: can someone queue a CI rerun with extra logging (TEST_VERBOSE=1) so we get the full interleaving trace?
ci-bot: rerun queued: job 3429 (TEST_VERBOSE=1) — https://ci.redwood/3429
ci-bot: job 3429 finished — 99 passed, 1 failed (flake). attached log snippet.
kaito: starting git bisect locally now over abc123..def456, will try to minimize to a single commit. allocating ~30m; assigning to myself. :hammer_and_wrench:
devon: if bisect points to my scheduler tweak I'll try a quick revert and test. otherwise may need to add stronger synchronization in allocator.
maria: let's not mark the test flaky on main yet. if bisect implicates a merge commit we should consider a revert or hotfix PR. Keep this thread updated. :eyes:
aj: thanks — I'll monitor CI and keep the ticket updated. ping me if you need any infra (more CI runs, larger concurrency matrix). :thumbsup:
